import { EditorialFootnote, EditorialTextButton } from "@godxjp/ui/layout";

name: EditorialFootnote
related: EditorialNote — a ruled aside in a reading column.
tagline: A quiet closing line under a collection or a settings form (gh#1439): a muted note at the start and an optional action (an EditorialTextButton) at the end. Geometry: `--editorial-footnote-*`.
usage: DO keep it to one or two sentences.
